features.title: Install ownership, guards, --json, --pr, uninstall
features.user_visible_behavior: asdd install protects kit files the project changed, refuses interrupted installs and downgrades, prints JSON for tools, can open the install as a pull request; asdd uninstall removes only what the kit added.
features.evidence: cli/test/install-lifecycle.test.mjs 8/8 (semver; edited kit files skipped on upgrade + recorded + doctor warns, --force overwrites; unedited file updated; interrupted-install marker and downgrade refused unless --force; --json result and error objects; uninstall keeps changed files/specs/project.json/filled binding, removes kit files, links, hooks, kit mcp servers and gitignore lines; pr preflight codes; --pr against a local bare origin with a fake gh: branch from origin/main, commit, push, PR URL, back on main with a clean tree; failed install mid-PR rolled back; branch-exists refused). npm test exit 0: vendor check, install smoke, lifecycle, unit 108/108.
